name: Hitz Lush Ice
description:
Embracing the Cool Refreshment of Lush Ice

Hitz Official Website, Dive into a world of icy bliss with Hitz Xtra’s Lush Ice flavor. This invigorating blend combines the crispness of menthol with a hint of sweetness, delivering a vaping experience that’s as refreshing as a cool breeze on a hot summer day. Indulge in the exhilarating chill of Lush Ice and awaken your senses with every inhale.

Hitz Official Website Unveiling Hitz Disposable Xtra

Elevate your vaping experience with Hitz Disposable Xtra. Crafted for convenience and satisfaction, Hitz Xtra offers a range of nicotine vape disposables featuring bold flavors and smooth hits. Each device is pre-filled with premium e-liquid and boasts a powerful battery to ensure long-lasting enjoyment. Whether you’re a seasoned vaper or new to the world of vaping, Hitz Disposable Xtra provides a hassle-free and enjoyable vaping experience that’s perfect for any occasion.

 Cooling Effects of Lush Ice

Feel the chill of refreshment with Hitz Xtra Lush Ice flavor. This exhilarating blend not only tantalizes the taste buds but also offers cooling effects that invigorate the mind and body. Experience an instant rush of icy menthol with every puff, leaving you feeling refreshed and revitalized. Whether you’re seeking a quick pick-me-up or a moment of relaxation, Lush Ice from Hitz Xtra  promises a vaping experience that’s as cool as it is satisfying.

You may Also like our other flavors Mango peach watermelon and   strawberry watermelon passionfruit 

Dabwoods disposable, kream dispo, burst extracts, zero gravity disposable, shorties disposable
